subject.title: Simplify Talk controls and move advanced defaults to Settings

question: Should advanced browser Talk controls now be Settings-owned admin defaults instead of per-session composer overrides for non-admin operators?
rationale: The code change is mechanically plausible, but that user-facing authority shift affects existing operator workflows and is a product boundary choice rather than a purely technical fix.

options.title: Accept Settings-owned advanced defaults
options.body: Proceed after the changelog line is removed and maintainers intentionally own the admin-gated Settings model for provider, transport, reasoning, and exact VAD/timing defaults.

options.title: Preserve per-session advanced overrides
options.body: Revise the PR so non-admin operators retain session-scoped provider/transport/reasoning/timing controls while Settings only provides persistent defaults.

options.title: Split runtime defaults from composer simplification
options.body: Land the config/provider default support separately and revisit the composer UX after explicit product review.

recommendation.title: Accept Settings-owned advanced defaults
recommendation.body: Proceed after the changelog line is removed and maintainers intentionally own the admin-gated Settings model for provider, transport, reasoning, and exact VAD/timing defaults.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent history on the Google, gateway Talk, docs, and config surfaces and is the clearest owner for this product boundary decision.
